description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.57 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.46 Å. Co is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.71 Å) and one longer (1.76 Å) Co-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 14°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-33°.
